summary_md: **[@tadanorealai](https://x.com/tadanorealai/status/2115535543006367873)** shares the **VibeVideoBench** paper, which evaluates multimodal agents on *code-driven* video generation (video produced by writing code rather than sampling a video model), and in a [follow-up](https://x.com/tadanorealai/status/2115536516584034355) links the benchmark's project site.

referenced_urls.title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation

relevance: A benchmark for exactly the agentic programmatic-video workflow (Remotion/HyperFrames style) appearing across this topic.
